card.name: Hyphenated unit starts after numbers
card.fires_on: The piece right after a number where a measurement unit is about to be spelled out, such as -n before anometer, -G before Hz, K before Wh, or -k before m. It fires mostly in technical text about chip sizes and frequencies.

modes.label: Chip process sizes
modes.description: A hyphen plus n after a number, starting the word nanometer.

modes.label: Frequency and power units
modes.description: The start of GHz or kWh right after a number.

modes.label: Distance units
modes.description: A hyphen plus k after a number, starting kilometer.

card.writes: It boosts lowercase unit pieces like kb, meg and nm and suppresses capital M and G, so the unit is not spelled with those letters.
card.plain: It fires when a number is followed by the first letters of a unit like nanometer, GHz or kWh.
